acceptance_criteria.text: A review-fix runner child that emits diagnostic stdout or stderr beyond the fixed capture capacity continues running until it exits or the existing timeout stops it; the captured diagnostic output contains the most recent retained content and an explicit truncation indication.

The program runner provides the same fixed-capacity tail capture and explicit truncation indication for diagnostic child output without terminating a child merely because its diagnostic output reaches the capture capacity.
A path that reads child output as validation input, including verdict-envelope extraction, retains its existing output bound and fails closed when that bound is exceeded.

Phase-command and pre-review execution continue to reject invalid invocation configuration, use the repository-root working directory, enforce their timeout and recursion protections, and stop at the first command failure.

constraints.text: Diagnostic child-output capture has a fixed memory capacity and preserves the tail rather than treating capacity exhaustion as a process failure; the existing timeout remains responsible for stopping a non-terminating child.
The diagnostic-capture policy must remain separate from output used as a verification input, so that validation paths retain their bounded, fail-closed behavior.

The change refines only diagnostic-output handling within infrastructure-owned bounded process execution; it does not alter command sequencing, command interpretation, or the existing invocation-validation contract.

goal.text: Allow long-running child processes to complete while retaining bounded, useful diagnostic output, without weakening the fail-closed output handling required when child output is itself a verification input.

in_scope.text: Change diagnostic stdout and stderr capture in the review-fix runner to fixed-capacity tail-ring retention, including a clear indication when earlier output was truncated.
Apply the same diagnostic capture behavior to the program runner's equivalent child-process output surface, so reaching the diagnostic capacity does not kill the child.
Preserve the separate bounded, fail-closed handling for child output whose contents are consumed as validation input, including verdict-envelope extraction.

out_of_scope.text: Using tail-ring capture for verdict envelopes or any other child-output path whose contents are used as verification input.
Changing timeout behavior, invocation-config validation, repository-root working-directory enforcement, recursion detection, or first-failure command sequencing.
Providing durable full-log storage for diagnostic output beyond the bounded tail retained by the process runner.

title: 子プロセスの診断出力を末尾リングで保持し、出力量による kill を廃止する
